description:
Marketing Intern (Apprentice) – Saba

Are you passionate about marketing, data, and understanding what drives brand growth? This is an opportunity to develop your career working with Saba, contributing to real marketing projects and turning market and consumer information into meaningful business insights.

About The Role

At Essity, we are looking for a Marketing Intern to join the Saba Marketing team in Santa Fe, Mexico City.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to learn how a consumer goods brand is managed from an end-to-end perspective, combining brand strategy, business and consumer analysis, and point-of-sale execution.

You will work with sales, market share, pricing, competitive, and profitability data, while also contributing to innovation projects, product launches, and portfolio management. You will collaborate closely with teams such as Sales, Finance, Consumer Insights, Trade Marketing, and Regulatory Affairs, as well as external agencies.

We are looking for someone who is curious, proactive, and analytical, but above all, eager to learn and take ownership of projects from start to finish.

We are looking for people who embody our values, who are not afraid to challenge, innovate, experiment, and move at a fast pace. We are always looking for ways to improve our products and ourselves. If this sounds like you, we’d love to talk.

What You Will Do


Support the development and execution of marketing initiatives and brand strategies for Saba, while contributing to innovation, product launches, and portfolio projects.
Analyze market and business information to identify trends, opportunities, and risks based on indicators such as Sales In, Sales Out, market share, P&L, and pricing.
Monitor competitors and category performance, including promotions, pricing dynamics, and relevant market trends, to generate insights and recommendations.
Follow up on point-of-sale execution across channels such as supermarkets, pharmacies, and hard discount, including store visits to gain a deeper understanding of consumers and market dynamics.
Conduct consumer and category analyses and research, using quantitative and qualitative information to support business decisions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external agencies, following up on projects, owners, timelines, and deliverables to ensure successful execution.
Prepare business reports and executive presentations, turning complex data and information into clear messages and actionable recommendations.


Who You Are


You are currently studying Marketing, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or a related field, with approximately 18 months remaining before graduation.
You have advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken, enabling you to work with international information and teams.
You have a good command of Excel and are comfortable working with databases, pivot tables, lookup functions, formulas, and charts.
You have an analytical mindset and enjoy going beyond the data to understand what it means and what business opportunities it may reveal.
You are proactive, curious, and eager to learn, with the ability to research, ask questions, and suggest new ways of doing things.
You demonstrate a strong sense of ownership and accountability, following up on your tasks and projects through completion.
You are organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high-quality deliverables.
You communicate clearly, enjoy working with different stakeholders, and build strong relationships to move projects forward.


It will be a plus if you have experience or familiarity with PowerPoint, Nielsen, Power BI, or other market data sources, or if you are interested in point-of-sale execution and understanding consumer behavior.

What We Can Offer You

Our purpose, Breaking Barriers to Well-being, provides meaning to everything we do. Join us to improve well-being for people and drive positive change for society and the environment. At Essity, you will feel valued, have opportunities to grow, and be challenged to deliver business results in an open and collaborative environment.

Innovate for Good | Excel Together | Be You with Us

description:
Strategic Student Program (SSP) – Marketing & Events Intern

Discover your career with us at Siemens Digital Industries Software!

We are a leading global software company dedicated to helping innovative companies transform the way they design, engineer and manufacture products. With the resources of a global organization and the energy of a technology-driven environment, our culture encourages creativity, fresh thinking, collaboration and continuous growth.

We are currently recruiting students for our Mexico Strategic Student Program. Our internship opportunities are designed to provide students with meaningful, hands-on experience where they can apply their education to real business challenges, develop new capabilities and gain exposure to different teams, partners, customers and leaders.

About The Role

The Marketing & Events Intern will be an active member of the Mexico Marketing team, supporting the planning and execution of marketing programs across events, digital channels, communications, demand generation and partner activities.

The person joining the team will have ownership of specific activities and projects and will work closely with Marketing, Sales, Channel Partners, vendors and other internal and external stakeholders.

The role requires someone who is proactive, organized, comfortable communicating with different audiences and willing to take ownership from planning through execution and follow-up.

Previous professional experience is not required. However, we are looking for students who can demonstrate initiative, problem-solving, teamwork and ownership through academic projects, student organizations, competitions, volunteering, entrepreneurship, events or other relevant experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Events & Experiences

Support the end-to-end planning and execution of in-person and digital events, including customer events, webinars, seminars, conferences, partner activities and other marketing experiences.

Responsibilities may include:


Support event planning, timelines, logistics and coordination from initial concept through execution and post-event follow-up.
Coordinate with internal teams, external vendors, venues, speakers, partners and sponsors.
Support vendor communication, quotations, deliverables and execution requirements.
Develop and maintain event timelines, checklists and run-of-show documents.
Support on-site execution and ensure activities, suppliers and deliverables are coordinated according to plan.
Support virtual and digital event execution when applicable.
Coordinate event communications, including Save the Dates, invitations, reminders, teasers and follow-up communications.
Support registration processes and registration pages.
Collect attendee feedback through post-event surveys and other feedback mechanisms.
Review event results, participant feedback and generated opportunities to identify learnings and opportunities for future optimization.
Prepare event recaps and communicate key results and insights to relevant stakeholders.


Digital Marketing & Social Media

Support and help execute the digital and social media strategy for the Mexico organization, with particular focus on LinkedIn and other relevant digital channels.

Responsibilities may include:


Support the development and execution of the LinkedIn content calendar.
Identify relevant company, customer, partner and industry content that can be amplified through our channels.
Create and adapt social media assets and copy.
Publish events, company updates, relevant news and marketing content.
Monitor engagement and incoming interactions and ensure appropriate follow-up when needed.

Track channel performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement and content effectiveness.

Marketing Programs & Campaign Execution

Support the execution of marketing programs aligned with business priorities for both the Direct Sales and Channel organizations.

Responsibilities may include:


Work closely with Marketing, Sales and Channel teams to understand business priorities and translate them into marketing activities.
Support demand generation and communication campaigns throughout their execution.
Coordinate activities with partners and follow up on agreed marketing initiatives and deliverables.
Support the implementation and adoption of marketing execution best practices.
Help coordinate multiple marketing activities simultaneously while maintaining visibility of timelines, stakeholders and deliverables.
Support campaign execution and follow-up, including reviewing results and identifying potential optimization opportunities.
Collaborate with different stakeholders to ensure activities remain aligned with current business priorities.


Content & Marketing Asset Development

Support the creation, adaptation and execution of marketing and communication materials across different channels.

This may include:


Flyers and digital invitations
Email communications and email campaigns
Social media assets
Videos and short-form content
Event teasers
Save the Dates
Posters and event signage
Presentations
Registration pages
Landing pages
Web content
Other digital and physical marketing materials


The candidate is not expected to be an expert in every design or marketing platform. However, basic experience with creative tools and, more importantly, the ability and willingness to quickly learn new platforms and technologies are important for the role.

Project & Stakeholder Management


Take ownership of assigned activities and follow them through completion.
Coordinate with multiple stakeholders and proactively follow up on pending actions and deliverables.
Communicate risks, challenges or delays early and propose potential solutions.
Participate actively in meetings and contribute ideas and recommendations.
Communicate and present information to different audiences, which may include vendors, partners, customers, Sales teams, Marketing teams and senior leadership.
Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
Ask questions and seek the information or resources necessary to move projects forward rather than waiting for detailed instructions at every step.


Candidate Profile

We are looking for a student with energy, curiosity, initiative and a strong willingness to learn. Because this role involves significant interaction with people and ownership of projects, communication skills and professional confidence are particularly important.

The ideal candidate demonstrates:


Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
Confidence communicating with different audiences and levels of seniority.
An outgoing and collaborative personality, comfortable approaching and interacting with new people.
Proactivity and initiative — someone who looks for the next step rather than waiting to be told what to do.
Ownership and accountability, with the ability to take responsibility for an activity from beginning to end.
An action-oriented mindset and willingness to make things happen.
Problem-solving skills and the ability to react constructively when plans change or challenges arise.
Decision-making ability and good judgment, appropriate to their level of responsibility.
The confidence to speak up, ask questions, challenge when appropriate and communicate when support is needed.
A willingness to go beyond the immediate task, identify additional needs and propose ideas or improvements.
Strong organization, prioritization and follow-up skills.
Ability to manage multiple activities and stakeholders simultaneously.
Ability to receive feedback and direction while maintaining sufficient autonomy to move work forward.
Curiosity and a fast-learning mindset, particularly when exposed to unfamiliar tools, processes or topics.

Requirements


Active university student in the final two or three semesters of their degree.

Experience We Value

Previous professional experience is not required.

Instead, we encourage candidates to share examples from university or extracurricular experiences where they have:


Led or coordinated a complex team project.
Organized an event, competition, conference, student initiative or similar activity.
Worked with multiple stakeholders toward a common deadline.

We are less interested in the title of the experience and more interested in what the candidate personally did, how they approached the challenge and what result they achieved.

What Success Looks Like In This Role

Becario/a de Marketing Digital y Creación de Contenido

Empresa: MOLDESA ENVASES

Ubicación: Zapopan, Jalisco

Modalidad: Híbrida (presencial y remota)

Tipo de puesto: Medio tiempo o tiempo completo, con horario flexible




Descripción de la empresa

MOLDESA ENVASES es una empresa dedicada al diseño, fabricación y comercialización de envases plásticos para diferentes industrias, como alimentos, bebidas, cosmética, limpieza y más.

Buscamos fortalecer nuestra presencia digital, conectar con nuevos clientes y desarrollar estrategias de contenido que comuniquen el valor de nuestros productos. Por ello, queremos integrar a nuestro equipo a una persona con creatividad, iniciativa y ganas de aprender, que desee adquirir experiencia práctica en marketing digital y creación de contenido.




Descripción de la vacante

Buscamos un/a estudiante, recién egresado/a o persona interesada en desarrollarse profesionalmente en el área de marketing digital, con facilidad para comunicarse frente a la cámara, crear contenido audiovisual e investigar tendencias de mercado.

La persona seleccionada participará en la planeación de contenido, grabación y edición de videos, gestión de redes sociales e investigación de nuevas oportunidades para posicionar nuestra marca.

No es necesario dominar todos los procesos desde el inicio. Valoramos especialmente la iniciativa, la creatividad, la capacidad de aprender y el interés por comprender cómo funciona el mercado para transformar ideas en contenido atractivo y útil para nuestros clientes.

Queremos que esta persona se involucre en los proyectos, proponga ideas y desarrolle habilidades que le permitan crecer profesionalmente mientras contribuye al crecimiento de la empresa.




Responsabilidades principales

Planeación de contenido: apoyar en la elaboración de calendarios de publicaciones y organización de ideas para redes sociales.
Creación de videos: participar frente a la cámara para presentar productos, explicar sus características y comunicar ideas de manera natural.
Grabación y edición: producir videos cortos y contenido visual para Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn y otras plataformas.
Investigación de mercado: estudiar tendencias, competidores, clientes potenciales y referencias de contenido para identificar nuevas oportunidades.
Conocimiento de productos: aprender sobre nuestros envases, sus aplicaciones, características y procesos de fabricación para desarrollar contenido auténtico.
Gestión de redes sociales: apoyar en la preparación, publicación y seguimiento de contenido digital.
Propuestas creativas: desarrollar ideas para campañas, videos y estrategias que ayuden a mejorar el posicionamiento de la marca.
Seguimiento de resultados: revisar métricas básicas de alcance, reproducciones e interacción para identificar oportunidades de mejora.
Apoyo comercial: crear contenido que ayude a presentar nuestros productos, atraer clientes potenciales y generar oportunidades de venta.

Requisitos

Ser estudiante, recién egresado/a o contar con interés en desarrollarse en marketing, comunicación, publicidad, producción audiovisual o áreas relacionadas.
Tener facilidad para hablar frente a la cámara o disposición para desarrollar esta habilidad.
Contar con conocimientos básicos de grabación y edición de video. Se valorará el manejo de CapCut, Premiere Pro o herramientas similares.
Tener interés por investigar tendencias, analizar el mercado y comprender al público objetivo.
Ser una persona creativa, organizada, responsable y con iniciativa.
Tener disposición para aprender sobre productos, procesos de fabricación y estrategias comerciales.
Manejar redes sociales y conocer sus principales formatos de contenido.
Se valorará contar con un portafolio de videos, publicaciones o proyectos personales, escolares o profesionales.
Saber ingles y hablar fluidamente 

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Horario flexible: buscamos acordar un horario que se adapte tanto a las necesidades de la empresa como a la disponibilidad de la persona seleccionada.
Dos opciones de jornada: posibilidad de colaborar medio tiempo o tiempo completo, según el perfil y los acuerdos establecidos.
Modalidad híbrida: combinación de trabajo presencial en nuestras instalaciones de Zapopan y actividades remotas, de acuerdo con las tareas y la planeación.
Experiencia práctica: participación en proyectos reales de marketing, creación de contenido y desarrollo de estrategias digitales.
Aprendizaje profesional: oportunidad de conocer el funcionamiento de una empresa, sus productos, sus clientes y sus procesos comerciales.
Libertad para proponer ideas: buscamos escuchar propuestas creativas y dar espacio para desarrollar nuevas iniciativas.
Desarrollo de habilidades: experiencia en investigación de mercado, producción audiovisual, comunicación digital y marketing orientado a resultados.

Las condiciones de horario, presencialidad y apoyo económico se acordarán de manera clara durante el proceso de selección.




¿Qué tipo de persona buscamos?

Buscamos a alguien con curiosidad, iniciativa y ganas de crecer. Una persona que disfrute crear contenido, investigar cómo se comunica el mercado y encontrar formas creativas de presentar productos.

Nos interesa especialmente alguien que no se limite a ejecutar instrucciones, sino que tenga iniciativa para investigar, proponer, organizar sus ideas y aprender de los resultados.

La facilidad para hablar frente a la cámara es importante, pero también valoramos la disposición para mejorar, la responsabilidad y el interés por comprender las necesidades de los clientes.




Modalidad y horario de trabajo

El puesto se desarrollará bajo una modalidad híbrida, combinando actividades presenciales en nuestras instalaciones de Zapopan con trabajo remoto cuando las tareas lo permitan.

La frecuencia de asistencia presencial y el horario se definirán de común acuerdo, considerando las necesidades de grabación, el conocimiento de los productos, las actividades del equipo y la disponibilidad de la persona seleccionada.

Podrá proponerse una jornada de medio tiempo o de tiempo completo, buscando una organización que permita cumplir con los objetivos del puesto y mantener un equilibrio con las actividades académicas, cuando corresponda.




Objetivo del puesto

Contribuir al desarrollo de una estrategia de contenido digital constante y bien organizada que fortalezca la presencia de MOLDESA ENVASES, comunique el valor de nuestros productos y ayude a atraer nuevos clientes y oportunidades comerciales, mientras la persona seleccionada adquiere experiencia práctica y desarrolla sus habilidades profesionales.

Siemens Industry Software Inc.

Strategic Student Program (SSP) – Technical Content Creator Intern 

Discover your career with us at Siemens Industry Software!

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

We’re currently recruiting students for our Mexico Strategic Student Program. Our intern positions will allow you to find a career path that most inspires you. description:

ABM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll be the closest partner our commercial teams have inside Growth Marketing, working daily with US-based sales and account leaders. This is a hands-on individual contributor position that blends account-based campaign execution with building the AI-powered automations that tell sellers exactly when to act. This is your opportunity to shape how data and AI directly drive new deals and account expansion, using tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.




What You'll Do:




- Plan and run account-based campaigns for target and existing accounts across email, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail, coordinated with each account's sales owner.

- Map commercial processes with sales and account teams and build automations (CRM, Clay, n8n/Make/Zapier, LLM steps) that detect account signals and alert sellers when to take action.

- Build and maintain the data behind these programs, including target-account lists, buying committees, and enriched account and contact records in CRM portals.

- Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

- 2+ years building automations used by sellers, such as signal/trigger-based workflows, data enrichment, and lead/account routing with tools like Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, or Salesforce workflows.

- 2+ years working with US-based commercial teams or marketing to US B2B buyers.

- Hands-on experience executing multi-channel campaigns across at least three of: email sequences, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail/gifting, with email sequences and LinkedIn required.

- Daily, hands-on use of generative AI or LLM tools (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini accepted) inside automations, not only for writing copy.

- Native or bilingual proficiency in English.




Nice to have:




- Industrial or process engineering background, or documented process-mapping work (BPMN, swimlanes in Lucidchart/Miro) used to design sales or marketing workflows.

- Experience in B2B tech services, IT staffing, or nearshore/outsourcing companies.

- Background running campaigns aimed at existing accounts, such as expansion, cross-sell, or renewal plays with account managers.

- Familiarity with intent data or ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora, Common Room).

- Scripting experience for automations (Python, JavaScript, or SQL; APIs and webhooks).




How we do make your work (and your life) easier:




- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.




Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

Remote (LATAM) · Reports to our Co-CEO




About Viva Talent

Viva Talent connects US companies with Executive Assistants and Recruiting Coordinators and opens meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America and South Africa. This is a build-and-lead seat: you’ll set the strategy, get it moving yourself, then hire and coach the team that runs it. If getting into the weeds makes you excited, this is your seat. You’re a hands-on marketing leader who has already solved this challenge elsewhere.

5+ years managing & leading marketing teams end to end, from defining the strategy to driving execution and results.

Executive-level English (C1+). You keep up in fast-paced conversations with executives, clearly explain your decisions and the reasoning behind them, and negotiate trade-offs and how plans move forward.




Why you’ll want this

This is a rare seat where you build the function instead of inheriting it. You'll own the number, the playbook, and the team, with a direct line to the founders and real autonomy over how Viva grows.

The work you’ll do will be pivotal to Viva’s growth, revenue, and team and will directly impact how we reach our mission of creating 1,000 meaningful career opportunities across Latin America.

We invest heavily in our people through:

100% remote work, forever.
Competitive compensation with reviews every six months and performance bonuses.

Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.

description:
You're writing copy for brands you don't care about. The work is fine. The numbers are good. And none of it matters to you anymore.




Another SaaS launch. Another "exciting new feature." Another founder who thinks "synergy" belongs in a subject line. You've sat on feedback calls where someone said "it's not catchy enough" and couldn't tell you what catchy meant. You've delivered 20 subject line alternatives because the first 19 were "good first effort!" One client texted you on a holiday. One called at midnight. One cancelled the project after the copy was written and acted like you should be grateful for the experience.




And somewhere in the middle of all that, something worse happened. Quieter than a bad client. You started losing your own voice. Writing for so many brands that thrive on inauthenticity that your instincts flattened. The part of you that cared whether the copy was brilliant or just adequate went quiet. Nobody was asking for brilliant. They were asking for adequate on a deadline.




But that's not who you are.




You're the person who's up at 6:47 am on a Saturday rewriting a subject line that's been bothering you since Thursday. Not for a deadline. Not for a client. Because it's not right yet and that's enough of a reason.




You sit in a restaurant, look at the menu, and think "who signed off on this?" You screenshot landing pages that work. You reverse-engineer email sequences from brands you'll never work for, just to understand what they did.




You know the rush of nailing a subject line before the data confirms it. You take it personally when one underperforms. Not in a dramatic way. In a "this could be better and I already know how" way.




The question that keeps surfacing isn't just "is there a place where the writing matters?"




Is there a place where I get to care again?




Keep reading.




- - -




This is the person on the other end of your email.




Picture the woman who opens your email on a Tuesday morning. Her name is Margaret. She's 68. She lives alone. Her knees hurt, her back hurts, her hands hurt. She's spent thousands on programs that didn't work. She's been told "that's just age" by doctors who shrugged. She's starting to wonder if this is just how it ends.




She opens your email. Not because of a subject line trick. Because she trusts the voice. Because the last email felt like someone actually understood what it's like to be her.




That voice is you. That's the job.




- - -




Here's where you'd do it.




The Fitness Doctor exists because most fitness programs don't work for people over 50. Not because the science isn't there. Because nobody translates it into something a 68-year-old widow with chronic knee pain actually trusts enough to try. Research-backed movement science. The kind where people actually get their lives back. Most of the people you'd write for are women. Sixties and seventies. Post-menopausal. Many are widows. Many are dealing with the quiet terror of losing the independence they worked 35 years to earn.




The team doesn't just market to these people. They do the physical training themselves. That's not a line in a culture deck. It's Tuesday morning at 7 am.




The work is remote and asynchronous. What matters is what you produce, not when you're online.




You'd write in one voice. Not yours. The founder's. His name is Robbie, and he talks to his audience like they're friends sitting in his living room. Your job is to disappear completely. If you can't do that, if you need your voice in everything you write, this isn't the role.




You'd write emails, sales letters, campaign copy. You'd architect launches from pre-launch to post-launch.




You'd work inside ActiveCampaign. Load emails into templates, apply tags, understand segments and contact flows.




You'd look at open rates, click rates, and conversion data and adjust copy accordingly. The data isn't decoration. It's direction.




As you grow, you'd build automations and workflows in the CRM. Design segmentation strategy. Not just "what tag goes where" but "why this segment gets this message at this moment." Build quiz funnels. Write affiliate swipes. Write hook-first ad copy for social platforms.




This role needs fluent English. Not "good English." Fluent. Nuance matters when your reader is a 68-year-old woman in chronic pain who has been let down by every program she's tried.




It needs self-discipline. Nobody here micromanages your calendar. You see what needs writing and you write it. You see what's broken and you flag it.




And it needs coachability. You'll get direct feedback on copy. Sometimes line-by-line. If your first instinct is to defend every word instead of pressure-testing whether the note makes the piece stronger, you'll hit a wall fast.




This isn't a "stay in your lane" role. It's an "everything you've ever learned finally matters" role.




- - -




Now let me save us both some time.




I'm Jon. I run the marketing side. And I'd rather be straight with you now than waste three weeks finding out we're not a fit.




There's the copywriter who needs a three-page brief before they can write three paragraphs. We have frameworks, templates, a voice guide, and a review process. What we don't have is the bandwidth to hand-hold every send. If you need to be told what to write, you'll suffocate here. If you see what needs to be written and write it, you'll thrive.




There's the copywriter who writes "salesy" copy. Countdown timers. "ONLY 3 SPOTS LEFT." Scarcity manipulation. Fear-based CTAs. The numbers often look great in the short term. But our audience is a 68-year-old woman who has been manipulated by every program she's tried. She can smell it. And when she does, we lose her forever. Not just the sale. Her trust. If manipulation is your toolkit, this is not your brand.




There's the copywriter who can't write in someone else's voice. They've got a style. It's strong. It wins awards. It sounds like them. And it sounds nothing like Robbie. This is a place where your voice disappears into a brand and the brand gets stronger because of it. If that sounds suffocating, this isn't for you. If it sounds like a craft challenge you'd enjoy, keep reading.




There's the copywriter who disappears between deadlines. Delivers on time, good work, but between sends they're a ghost. No check-ins, no ideas, no presence. We're a small team. Campaigns overlap. Priorities shift. If you show up only when it's time to deliver, you're missing the part where the real thinking happens.




And there's the copywriter who only wants to write. "Don't ask me to tag a contact. Don't ask me to look at a dashboard. Don't ask me to think about what happens after they click." If the word "automation" makes your eyes glaze over, we're not compatible. The best emails in the world are worthless if the funnel behind them is broken.




If any of that is you, we wish you well. No hard feelings.




- - -




Here's what you get.




A home.




Not a gig. Not another agency that assigns you a brand on Monday and moves you to a different one by Friday. Not the feast-and-famine cycle where a great month is followed by silence.




A single brand you can invest in. One audience you can study and serve better every quarter. The kind of relationship with a brand where you stop writing AT people and start writing FOR someone. Where you know Margaret's fears and hopes well enough that the copy writes itself some mornings.




A team that values what you bring beyond the copy. Every skill you've accumulated that's been wasted because you were "just the writer" somewhere else. It matters here. Write emails today, architect a launch next week, shape a quiz funnel the week after. The variety isn't a perk. It's the job.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Technical Account Managers work cross-functionally to support Stripe’s largest and most complex users. Through trusted relationships we offer customized, strategic consultations and proactively identify opportunity areas to help businesses deliver more value to their customers, optimize technical operations on their teams, and accelerate their global growth with Stripe.

What you’ll do

Strategically support Stripe’s largest and most complex users.

Responsibilities


Provide a gold standard experience to your assigned accounts’ key stakeholders
Work with the wider Operations team to provide current state, resources and knowledge to enable gold standard experience across teams interacting directly with the user via support channels, external documentation, or product/feature feedback or development
Foster long term user relationships that grow loyalty to Stripe and Stripe products
Work cross-functionally both internally and within your user’s organizations to provide and implement operational solutions on subjects not limited to fraud/disputes, declines, product adoption and global expansion
Work closely with Account Management and other user facing teams as part of a larger effort to support users on Stripe
Lead user facing meetings both in person and through video chat
Collaborate on the continued design of this support offering
Create user-facing content for long term solutions



Who you are

We are looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


5+ years experience in enterprise level client-facing work
Strong product sense and energized by the challenge of solving difficult user related problems
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to lead complex integration conversations in a highly consultative and proactive manner
Familiarity with APIs and ability to explain API concepts to Stripe’s largest and most technical customers
Familiarity with SQL and comfort building basic queries and modifying more complex ones
Strong technical troubleshooting skills and experience interfacing with technical teams
Adept client relationship management skills
Ability to engage in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization
Bachelor's Degree required



Preferred Qualifications


Operations savvy mindset, with an ability to identify and eliminate process friction while continuing to build scalable processes
Experience practicing in small to medium scale project management
Strong organizational skills and self-starting mindset
Experience with tools like Postman, xCode, Python, Webhooks, and ETL
Experience in the payments industry



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

skills: Own the customer recovery motion, triaging high-impact queues of at-risk customers with a goal of proactive rescue and structured save motions.
Champion the core principle: Standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful. Use AI and automation tooling to handle administrative tasks, freeing capacity for deep-dive recovery work.
Drive momentum to value by acting as an internal consultant, coordinating across Sales, Onboarding, and Product to remove technical or operational blockers.
Own clear, customer-friendly communication, delivering concise and highly personalized updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Maintain clean systems and actionable data, logging activities in Salesforce and capturing "voice of the customer" signals to feed back to leadership.

Hospitality Roots: Significant direct experience in hotel/resort operations (front office, revenue, or property management). You must understand the real business impact when tech fails.
SaaS & Retention Experience: 2-5+ years in Post-Sales Ops, Onboarding, CS Ops, Renewals, or Customer Success in a B2B SaaS environment.

Deep experience across mid-market, enterprise, or multi-property hospitality (management companies, branded clusters, or large franchise models).

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, moving beyond traditional support to deliver measurable business value and drive the long-term adoption of the Samsara platform. Your mission is to proactively optimize your customers' technical health and mitigate risk, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes.

This requires a unique blend of deep technical acumen, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to communicate with influence across both technical and executive stakeholders. You will build enduring customer relationships by translating their operational goals into powerful technical solutions. As the primary technical interface for your accounts, you will foster cross-functional collaboration with our Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion your customers' needs. During critical incidents, you will demonstrate ownership by managing customer communications and expectations through to a successful resolution.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:


You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.



In this role, you will: 

Drive Customer Impact & Value Realization: Go beyond technical support to consistently deliver measurable value. You will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business objectives and proactively align Samsara's solutions to help them achieve their goals, tracking and demonstrating technical ROI along the way.
Use AI to Transform the Customer Experience: Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to anticipate customer needs, personalize engagement, and deliver faster, more proactive, and impactful outcomes.
Execute Transformational Technical Account Management: Independently manage a portfolio of accounts, developing tailored success plans and identifying and mitigating risks to customer health. You will maintain accurate records of customer interactions and contribute to team-wide objectives.
Demonstrate Deep Technical Acumen & Samsara Expertise: Be the primary technical point of contact, mastering Samsara's platform, including APIs, hardware, and software. You will advise customers on best practices and troubleshoot complex technical issues with proficiency.
Provide Consultative Problem Solving & Solutioning: Employ a consultative approach to understand the root cause of customer challenges. You will own the technical ticket lifecycle, including technical escalations from report to resolution, and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and drive product improvement.

Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and deliver a unified experience.
Demonstrate Ownership and Act as a Multiplier: Embody a 'get it done' mentality by taking initiative on team projects and process improvements. Embody Samsara's Values & Principles: Consistently champion and role model Samsara's core values and operating principles in every interaction, actively seeking feedback for continuous improvement



Minimum requirements for the role:

Experience: 7+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions consulting, or customer success, with a demonstrated track record of success. 
Education: We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
Technical Proficiency: Exceptional technical literacy with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and API integrations. A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, including an interest in AI and its applications.
Bilingual: English and Spanish is a must.
Customer Focus: A data-informed approach to understanding customer needs and a demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish is required. 
Collaborative Spirit: A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and works effectively with internal teams to drive customer success.



An ideal candidate also has:

Experience supporting global enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.
Proven experience leveraging AI tools and methodologies in daily workflows to drive efficiency, generate customer insights, and improve overall customer success.
Prior experience with Samsara, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gong, Gainsight, and Tableau.
Basic Python coding skills are an asset for providing enhanced technical solutions
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, moving beyond traditional support to deliver measurable business value and drive the long-term adoption of the Samsara platform. Your mission is to proactively optimize your customers' technical health and mitigate risk, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes.

This requires a unique blend of deep technical acumen, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to communicate with influence across both technical and executive stakeholders. You will build enduring customer relationships by translating their operational goals into powerful technical solutions. As the primary technical interface for your accounts, you will foster cross-functional collaboration with our Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion your customers' needs. During critical incidents, you will demonstrate ownership by managing customer communications and expectations through to a successful resolution.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:


You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.



In this role, you will: 

Drive Customer Impact & Value Realization: Go beyond technical support to consistently deliver measurable value. You will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business objectives and proactively align Samsara's solutions to help them achieve their goals, tracking and demonstrating technical ROI along the way.
Use AI to Transform the Customer Experience: Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to anticipate customer needs, personalize engagement, and deliver faster, more proactive, and impactful outcomes.
Execute Transformational Technical Account Management: Independently manage a portfolio of accounts, developing tailored success plans and identifying and mitigating risks to customer health. You will maintain accurate records of customer interactions and contribute to team-wide objectives.
Demonstrate Deep Technical Acumen & Samsara Expertise: Be the primary technical point of contact, mastering Samsara's platform, including APIs, hardware, and software. You will advise customers on best practices and troubleshoot complex technical issues with proficiency.
Provide Consultative Problem Solving & Solutioning: Employ a consultative approach to understand the root cause of customer challenges. You will own the technical ticket lifecycle, including technical escalations from report to resolution, and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and drive product improvement.
Communicate with Influence and Clarity: Lead customer meetings, from technical deep dives to quarterly technical account reviews, with confidence. You will adapt your communication style to effectively engage with diverse audiences, from technical staff to non-technical executives.
Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and deliver a unified experience.
Demonstrate Ownership and Act as a Multiplier: Embody a 'get it done' mentality by taking initiative on team projects and process improvements. You will actively contribute to our internal knowledge base and help onboard new team members, sharing best practices to enhance the entire team's capabilities.
Embody Samsara's Values & Principles: Consistently champion and role model Samsara's core values and operating principles in every interaction, actively seeking feedback for continuous improvement



Minimum requirements for the role:

Experience: 7+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions consulting, or customer success, with a demonstrated track record of success. 
Education: We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
Technical Proficiency: Exceptional technical literacy with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and API integrations. A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, including an interest in AI and its applications.
Bilingual: English and Spanish is a must.
Customer Focus: A data-informed approach to understanding customer needs and a demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish is required. 
Collaborative Spirit: A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and works effectively with internal teams to drive customer success.



An ideal candidate also has:

Experience supporting global enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.
Proven experience leveraging AI tools and methodologies in daily workflows to drive efficiency, generate customer insights, and improve overall customer success.
Prior experience with Samsara, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gong, Gainsight, and Tableau.
Basic Python coding skills are an asset for providing enhanced technical solutions
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Customer Recovery Coach
skills: Own the customer recovery motion, triaging high-impact queues of at-risk customers with a goal of proactive rescue and structured save motions.
Champion the core principle: Standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful. Use AI and automation tooling to handle administrative tasks, freeing capacity for deep-dive recovery work.
Drive momentum to value by acting as an internal consultant, coordinating across Sales, Onboarding, and Product to remove technical or operational blockers.
Own clear, customer-friendly communication, delivering concise and highly personalized updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Maintain clean systems and actionable data, logging activities in Salesforce and capturing "voice of the customer" signals to feed back to leadership.
Identify patterns of friction and propose systemic process improvements to stop issues before they start, ruthlessly eliminating hero-dependency.

Hospitality Roots: Significant direct experience in hotel/resort operations (front office, revenue, or property management). You must understand the real business impact when tech fails.
SaaS & Retention Experience: 2-5+ years in Post-Sales Ops, Onboarding, CS Ops, Renewals, or Customer Success in a B2B SaaS environment.
AI Smarts: Exceptional technical aptitude. You understand how to leverage AI to unlock time for human-to-human relationships.
Caring Rebel Spirit: Proven ability in emotional intelligence, trust-building, and high-stakes de-escalation with customers at all levels.
Process Discipline: Detail-oriented and rigorous about documentation and CRM hygiene.
Deep experience across mid-market, enterprise, or multi-property hospitality (management companies, branded clusters, or large franchise models).
Fluency in multiple languages supported by Cloudbeds.

description:
𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲𝘀 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘂𝗱𝗯𝗲𝗱𝘀 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝗾𝘂𝗲

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

 

 

𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗬𝗼𝘂'𝗹𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗮𝗻 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁:

As a Customer Recovery Coach, you will model our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts—the mission for Cloudbeds Customer Success—sitting at the vital intersection of customer retention and product success. You will drive the shift from a reactive support function to an Intelligent Recovery Motion, leveraging early risk detection and firsthand hotel operations experience to turn frustration into loyalty. This role centers on orchestrating the Fire-Team concept—a cross-functional, executive-level intervention designed to deliver decisive issue resolution for our most critical accounts. You will be a Caring Rebel leader who understands that technology should handle the administrative drag, while humans handle the relationship magic. You will leverage AI-driven insights to proactively identify risk and design recovery processes that prove Cloudbeds is central to our customers' business success.

 

𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝗖𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗿 𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺:

Our Customer Success team is where Hospitality Hearts meet Smart Solutions. We are a fully-remote group of former hoteliers and customer experience professionals, focused on removing unnecessary manual work so we can focus on our human magic: building and strengthening relationships with our customers, and ensuring Cloudbeds remains central to their business success and guest service excellence. If you are driven by emotional intelligence, trust building, and delivering deeply personalized hospitality moments instead of repetitive operational work, you will feel right at home here.

 

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺:

Own the customer recovery motion, triaging high-impact queues of at-risk customers with a goal of proactive rescue and structured save motions.
Champion the core principle: Standardize the repeatable, personalize the meaningful. Use AI and automation tooling to handle administrative tasks, freeing capacity for deep-dive recovery work.
Drive momentum to value by acting as an internal consultant, coordinating across Sales, Onboarding, and Product to remove technical or operational blockers.
Own clear, customer-friendly communication, delivering concise and highly personalized updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Maintain clean systems and actionable data, logging activities in Salesforce and capturing "voice of the customer" signals to feed back to leadership.
Identify patterns of friction and propose systemic process improvements to stop issues before they start, ruthlessly eliminating hero-dependency.
Orchestrate the Fire-Team motion: Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for at-risk accounts, mobilizing internal stakeholders across Support, Product, and Engineering to restore trust and ensure the customer never has to ask "Who owns this?"
Execute the "Recovery Becomes Prevention" feedback loop: Treat cancellation requests as systemic failures rather than simple decision points; document root causes to identify and eliminate the friction points that deplete our customers and teams.
Implement "Rapid Wins": Prioritize immediate operational stabilization for customers by fixing top pain points first to restore confidence before reaching for perfection.

 

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗦𝗲𝘁𝘀 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗨𝗽 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀:

Hospitality Roots: Significant direct experience in hotel/resort operations (front office, revenue, or property management). You must understand the real business impact when tech fails.
SaaS & Retention Experience: 2-5+ years in Post-Sales Ops, Onboarding, CS Ops, Renewals, or Customer Success in a B2B SaaS environment.
AI Smarts: Exceptional technical aptitude. You understand how to leverage AI to unlock time for human-to-human relationships.
Caring Rebel Spirit: Proven ability in emotional intelligence, trust-building, and high-stakes de-escalation with customers at all levels.
Process Discipline: Detail-oriented and rigorous about documentation and CRM hygiene.

 

𝗕𝗼𝗻𝘂𝘀 𝗦𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀 𝘁𝗼 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗢𝘂𝘁:

Deep experience across mid-market, enterprise, or multi-property hospitality (management companies, branded clusters, or large franchise models).
Fluency in multiple languages supported by Cloudbeds.
 

 

𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸 𝗔𝘂𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘇𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

description:
Description

Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company? Come make history in Amazon’s team! We are looking for talented Program Manager to make it dramatically easier for sellers to launch and grow their business on our marketplace. In this role, you'll own the seller journey from registration end through first listing and early success, removing friction at every step so more sellers reach their first sale and long-term growth faster. You'll partner with product, tech, verification, and business teams to reinvent onboarding, accelerate sellers to key milestones, and turn seller pain points into solutions. If you love building programs that unlock growth for hundreds of thousands of sellers, this is for you.

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. Over 2 million Sellers in 10 countries list their products for sale on the Amazon Marketplace. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices.

Key job responsibilities

Drive seller listing success: Own programs that move sellers from registration to first listing and early revenue milestones, reducing onboarding friction and lifting funnel conversion.

Define and track success metrics: Build the program metrics, dashboards, and queries needed to measure funnel performance, set achievable goals, and report progress in WBRs/MBRs.

Ensure smooth GTM of new features: Plan and execute phased rollouts and dial-ups of new listing experiences, monitoring seller impact and iterating quickly on early results.

Educate and communicate with sellers: Create educational content, FAQs, and in-context guidance, and run seller comms across email, WhatsApp, and Seller Central.

Capture and act on Voice of Seller: Gather seller feedback and anecdotes, translate them into product requirements, and channel them to the right product and tech teams to close experience gaps.

Lead cross-functional execution: Coordinate and influence product, tech, verification, legal, and business partners (up to senior leadership) to align on requirements, roles, and delivery timelines.

Establish routines and mechanisms: Set up follow-up cadences, monitoring, and governance to detect issues early, track adoption, and continuously improve the seller experience.

Basic Qualifications


 Experience in program or project management
 Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
 Experience defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
 Bachelor's degree
 Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
 Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
 Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
 Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

En Natura creemos en el poder de las relaciones. Conectamos a través de vínculos de confianza y trabajamos como un ecosistema donde personas, negocios y marcas como Natura y Avon se mueven con un mismo propósito: impulsar transformaciones significativas mediante productos innovadores y negocios regenerativos que generan un impacto positivo.

Si tu propósito conecta y quieres formar parte de esta transformación, ¡este lugar es para ti!




Buscamos un perfil estratégico y altamente analítico, responsable de diseñar, desarrollar e implementar estrategias de incentivos y campañas comerciales dirigidas a nuestra fuerza de ventas.  




¿Qué harás aquí?

Crear y desarrollar campañas de incentivos para la fuerza de ventas que movilicen los KPIs a nivel negocio.
Capacidad para interpretar métricas de rendimiento de las campañas y/o incentivos, calcular el ROI y tomar decisiones basadas en datos para alcanzar los KPIs de la organización.

¿Qué encontrarás aquí?

Job Category

Marketing & Communications

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters

We're hiring an Associate Brand Designer to join Slack's Brand & Creative team. You'll help shape how the brand looks and feels across campaigns, events, social, swag, and product launches, working in close collaboration with senior designers.

The Role Has Three Areas Of Work


Concept exploration: generating and pitching many ideas that connect to Slack's key narratives and messaging, then helping the team find the strongest one.
Production at scale: turning approved concepts into on-brand assets at scale across digital and print, following brand guidelines.
Internal tools and AI workflows: building small, practical improvements that make the team faster, such as templates, automations, and shared prompt and asset libraries.


Core Responsibilities & Scope


Explore multiple directions for brand and campaign projects, using sketching, moodboarding, and AI tools, and pitch ideas that map back to key narratives and messaging.
Produce on-brand campaign, event, social, and swag assets at scale across digital and print, following style, voice, and tone guidelines
Use AI tools critically in your workflow and build templates, automations, and shared asset and prompt libraries that others can use in tools like Figma and Canva.
Manage your time against priorities, flag deadline risks early, and seek and apply feedback while presenting your work clearly to the team and partners.


Minimum Requirements


3-5 years of experience in brand, graphic, or visual design, with a portfolio that shows process, not just final output.
Strong typography, layout, color, and visual hierarchy skills, with proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
Experience working within brand design systems and templated production, across digital and print.
Conceptual thinking: you can explain the idea behind a design and show how it evolved, and you explore range before narrowing.
Strong written and verbal communication in English.
Regular, critical use of AI tools, with the ability to describe your workflow and keep output on-brand and original.


Preferred Qualifications


Comfort with no-code or low-code automation, or light scripting
Motion or video basics.
Familiarity with print production and working with vendors.

Our Values


Empathy - We care about the people we work with and the people we serve

Thriving - We create an environment where people can do their best work

WPP es la empresa de transformación creativa. Aprovechamos el poder de la creatividad para construir un futuro mejor para nuestra gente, el planeta, nuestros clientes y nuestras comunidades. Para obtener más información, visita wpp.com.

En WPP Media, creemos en el poder de nuestra cultura y de nuestra gente. Es lo que nos impulsa a ofrecer experiencias excepcionales tanto a nuestros clientes como entre nosotros. En este puesto, será fundamental adoptar los valores fundamentales compartidos por WPP y WPP Media:


Ser extraordinarios liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora.
Crear un ambiente abierto equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y de los clientes mediante el fomento de la confianza.

Google Ads.
Meta Ads Manager / TikTok Ads Manager.
DV360 y DSP (deseable).
Campaign Manager 360 (deseable).
Herramientas de reporting.
Medios AdVerification (deseable)


Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo, creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Viva Talent · Remote (LATAM) · Reports to our Co-CEO

Recommend growth and investment priorities. Identify opportunities to accelerate Viva’s core growth metric and recommend where to focus resources based on expected impact, speed to results, risks, and trade-offs.

5+ years in Revenue Operations, with hands-on ownership of systems and processes across the customer lifecycle.
C1 English and executive communication skills. You explain recommendations clearly, challenge assumptions constructively, and align stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.
You’ve built or significantly improved RevOps systems and processes (0-1 and 1-n), with the ability to take work from identifying the problem through implementation.
Hands-on HubSpot expertise, including lifecycle configuration, data governance, integrations, and automation.
Strong commercial judgment and independence. You identify priorities, weigh risks and trade-offs, and make recommendations that influence growth and investment decisions.
Advanced, hands-on AI and automation expertise. You’ve built and deployed workflows that significantly reduce manual work and expand what you can deliver independently, while validating accuracy and results.




Helpful experience: Working in a startup or lean team; direct sales or customer-facing experience; and familiarity with Clay, Zapier/Make/n8n, and advertising conversion integrations.




Why you'll want this

Viva’s ready for the next stage of growth, and you’ll be a key player, working alongside our Co-CEO and department heads.

You’ll have the autonomy to find our next bets, guide where we invest, and turn insights into action, helping us actually create more career opportunities for women across Latin America.

100% remote work, forever.
Competitive compensation with reviews every six months and performance bonuses.

Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.

A culture centered around growth, ownership, well-being, and continuous learning.

A focused process: application → initial interview → a practical skills assessment → hiring manager interview → final interview. We’ll share the details as you progress and respect your time.
