description:
Description

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to join the Amazon Payments Mexico marketing team. In this role, you will serve as the single-threaded owner of marketing execution for one or more payment products within the Amazon Mexico ecosystem. You will be responsible for converting marketing strategy into customer-facing outcomes through hands-on, week-by-week execution across onsite merchandising, promotions, performance reporting, and competitive intelligence.

This is a high-ownership, high-velocity role where you will manage the full execution lifecycle — from campaign creation and promotional configuration to post-campaign analysis — operating within Amazon's rigorous weekly business review cadence.

Key job responsibilities

Onsite Merchandising

Own all customer-facing placements on Amazon.com.mx including Maple campaigns (High Upsell Cards, Mobile View Cards, Priceblock banners, Wallet placements), DPIC content, Sparkle keyword campaigns, homepage hero banners, and landing pages

Manage creative briefing, review, scheduling coordination, and multi-channel QA across mobile, app, and desktop

Execute large-scale campaign rotations during High-Velocity Events (40+ onsite campaigns and 5–8 landing pages per event)

Configure targeting by card issuer and customer segment

Promotions & Discounts

Design promotional strategies for assigned payment products and navigate approval workflows with Finance and Legal

Configure promotions in relevant systems (PAWS, IBD coupon architecture, cashback configurations)

Coordinate with up to 14 issuing bank partners on offer structures, communication timing, and shared funding

Maintain a rolling pipeline of promotions planned quarters ahead and deliver post-promotion ROI reporting

Monitoring & Reporting

Produce weekly flash reports, WBR/MBR data pulls, and monthly deep-dive analyses

Maintain dashboards, detect anomalies, and deliver post-campaign performance reports and QBR inputs

Provide the feedback loop that determines campaign effectiveness, segment conversion, and budget efficiency

Competitive Intelligence

Conduct monthly structured competitive scans covering MercadoLibre, Liverpool, Coppel, major issuing banks, and emerging fintechs

Track feature launches, promotional mechanics, pricing changes, onsite merchandising tactics, and media spend shifts

Deliver intel summaries to the broader team and product partners

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation

Write campaign briefs, BRDs, 1-pagers, and post-mortem narratives

Participate in weekly syncs with product managers, agency partners, legal/compliance reviews, and team ceremonies

Operate within Amazon's written communication culture and weekly business review cadence

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
 Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
 Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
 Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
 Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting

description:
We’re hiring a Recruitment Marketing Manager to attract qualified candidates through social media, paid campaigns, and other channels across Latin America.




About Viva Talent




Viva Talent connects US companies with exceptional Executive Assistants and creates meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America. We’re a globally distributed team of 200+ people across 15+ countries and 3 continents, on a mission to expand real opportunity for women in LATAM.




Why we’re opening this role




We’re opening this role to make candidate generation more consistent as Viva’s hiring needs grow. We need a builder-minded manager who can set up and drive a recruitment marketing strategy, using social media, paid campaigns, and other channels to attract qualified candidates and help us broaden our mission to empower more women in LATAM to access meaningful job opportunities.




Responsibilities




Lead candidate demand generation: Build and manage a multi-channel strategy to attract candidates, with social media as a core channel.
Generate candidate leads and applications: Develop campaigns that grow qualified candidate volume and improve results using performance data.
Own paid campaigns end to end: Identify campaign needs, analyze the audience and opportunity, build and create ads, launch campaigns, measure their impact, and optimize performance.
Create and coordinate content: Develop original organic social content and coordinate staff- or influencer-generated content initiatives as relevant.
Build an effective function: Identify the processes, channels, tools, and partner support needed to make candidate generation scalable.
Start hands-on and grow into leadership: Begin as the sole recruitment marketing contributor, personally developing and running the work. As the function grows, take on people management and lead new team members.




Requirements




Marketing management: 3+ years in a marketing manager role, including at least 2 years with people management responsibilities.
Demand generation and results: Experience building a multi-channel strategy and increasing lead or application volume through campaigns. Use performance data to improve results and connect campaigns to pipeline impact, hires, and post-hire quality. Candidate-generation experience is ideal; customer or user lead generation is transferable (B2C preferred).
End-to-end paid campaigns: Assess campaign needs and audiences, build and create ads, launch campaigns, analyze impact, and optimize results. Hands-on experience with LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok.
Organic social content: Create consistent, original content that attracts candidates and encourages them to learn more or apply.
AI, automation, and systems: Use LLMs, tools such as Zapier or n8n, and vibe-coding tools such as Lovable to improve workflows. CRM experience is relevant. Bring original ideas and make independent creative decisions.

Provides strategic leadership to the digital organization, developing talent, strengthening capabilities, and building a sustainable succession pipeline.

Establishes strong partnerships with Brand, Marketing, Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, Regional, and Global teams to ensure alignment and delivery of business objectives.

Acts as a strategic partner to affiliate and regional leadership, influencing business decisions and driving the digital transformation agenda.

13+ years of experience in Digital Commerce, E-commerce, Online Marketing, Commercial or related functions.

English communication skills, both written and verbal.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Acerca de WPP Media

WPP es la empresa de transformación creativa. Aprovechamos el poder de la creatividad para construir un futuro mejor para nuestra gente, el planeta, nuestros clientes y nuestras comunidades. Para obtener más información, visita wpp.com.

WPP Media es el colectivo global de medios de WPP. En un mundo donde los medios están en todas partes y en todo, reunimos las mejores plataformas, personas y socios para crear oportunidades ilimitadas de crecimiento. Para obtener más información, visita wppmedia.com

En WPP Media, creemos en el poder de nuestra cultura y de nuestra gente. Es lo que nos impulsa a ofrecer experiencias excepcionales tanto a nuestros clientes como entre nosotros. En este puesto, será fundamental adoptar los valores fundamentales compartidos por WPP y WPP Media:


Ser extraordinarios liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora.
Crear un ambiente abierto equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y de los clientes mediante el fomento de la confianza.
Liderar con optimismo promoviendo el crecimiento y el desarrollo para movilizar a la empresa.


Responsabilidades


Control operativo y trazabilidad end-to-end: Centralizar y dar seguimiento riguroso al ciclo completo de operación de medios (seguimiento de la planeación, compra, implementación, reporting y conciliación) para las 6 marcas del portafolio.
Gestión de planes de trabajo y presupuestos: Supervisar la consistencia de la información, calendarios, fechas compromiso, presupuestos y entregables clave; identificar desviaciones y riesgos de manera oportuna.
Liderazgo de reporteo y analítica: Guiar al equipo operativo en el armado, estandarización, control de calidad y automatización de reportes periódicos con hallazgos accionables.
Coordinación de equipos e interacciones: Coordinar a los equipos involucrados para asegurar el cumplimiento de procesos, servir de enlace operativo con publishers / exclusivas de medios y liberar capacidad de los managers para que se enfoquen en la estrategia y crecimiento.
Visibilidad y estatus de marca: Dar visibilidad clara y estructurada sobre el estatus operativo transversal del portafolio al Media Lead / Director de Medios.


Habilidades y Experiencia


Licenciatura en Publicidad, Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.
Intermedio - Redacción fluida y presentación de informes ejecutivos en inglés.
3 a 5 años de experiencia general en la cadena operativa de medios (planeación, compra, implementación, reporting y conciliación), con al menos 1 o 2 años supervisando procesos o coordinando equipos tácticos.


Herramientas


Digital Ads & Trafficking: Display & Video 360 (DV360), Google Ads MCC, Meta Business Manager, TikTok Ads Manager.
Analytics & Control: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), dashboards de seguimiento y gestión de datos (Looker Studio, Power BI).
Retail Media & Programmatic: Plataformas programáticas y Retail Media Networks (ej. Mercado Libre Ads, Walmart Connect).


Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo, creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. Nuestro paquete integral de beneficios refleja este compromiso e incluye seguro médico, de visión y dental, planes grupales de retiro, un generoso programa de tiempo libre pagado, descuentos preferenciales con aliados y días dedicados al bienestar y la salud mental de nuestro equipo.

En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Por eso, hemos adoptado un modelo de trabajo híbrido, asistiendo a la oficina alrededor de tres días a la semana. Si requieres alguna adaptación o flexibilidad, te invitamos a conversarlo con el equipo de selección durante el proceso de entrevista. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Agradecemos a todas las personas que se postulen a esta vacante; sin embargo, solo contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados para una entrevista.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

Estamos fortaleciendo nuestra tienda en línea como una unidad de negocio con metas comerciales propias, y buscamos a la persona que la haga crecer.




EL RETO

Buscamos un perfil 100% comercial. No se trata solo de administrar la plataforma: serás responsable de vender más, convertir mejor y lograr que los clientes vuelvan a comprar. Tendrás meta de venta mensual y la libertad de proponer las acciones para alcanzarla.




¿QUÉ HARÁS PARA LOGRARLO?

•    Ser responsable de la meta de ventas mensual del canal e-commerce.

•    Analizar tráfico, conversión, ticket promedio, recompra y abandono de carrito.

•    Diseñar promociones, paquetes, estrategias de cross-selling y up-selling, y campañas de temporada.

•    Impulsar la recompra: programas de lealtad, clientes recurrentes y recuperación de clientes inactivos.

•    Gestionar catálogo, precios, promociones y fichas de producto con enfoque en rentabilidad.

•    Definir objetivos y medir los resultados de las campañas que ejecutan Marketing, Diseño y proveedores externos.

•    Coordinarte con Almacén, Logística y Atención a Clientes para asegurar una buena experiencia de compra.

•    Elaborar el forecast del canal y reportar resultados a Dirección.

•    Identificar nuevas oportunidades de venta en línea, como B2B y marketplaces.




¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS?

•    Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Administración, Negocios, Comercio Electrónico o afín.

•    3 años o más en un puesto así. 

•    Dominio de indicadores e-commerce: conversión, ticket promedio, recompra, LTV, CAC y ROAS.

•    Manejo de plataformas e-commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, VTEX, Tiendanube o similar) y Google Analytics, manejo de Mercado Libre o Amazon.

•    CRM y email marketing.

Desarrollar, coordinar e implementar planes y campañas de comunicación, tanto propias como subcontratadas con agencias, alineados a los objetivos de la fundación.

Buscar la participación en foros nacionales e internacionales, con el fin de darle visibilidad a la Fundación.
Administrar los presupuestos asignados a los proyectos, asegurando su eficiencia.

Job Description

At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold “what if.”

What if your ideas could ignite global innovation?

What if your curiosity could redefine the future?

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of your career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect 70% of the Fortune 500, and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.

How we empower our people is extraordinary: we’re recognized as a Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years; and what we build is world class: named CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024— clear evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next.”

In a world where you can be anything, Be Infoblox.

Program Manager, Strategic Communications

We have an opportunity for a Program Manager, Strategic Communications to join our Strategic Communications team in Mexico City, reporting to the Director, Strategic Communications. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, strategic communications, and employee engagement. You will translate company strategy and corporate priorities into clear narratives, engaging programs, and well-executed employee experiences that help people understand what matters, why it matters, and how they can contribute.

You will manage a portfolio of existing and emerging strategic communications and engagement programs, turning broad objectives into practical plans, coordinated experiences, and measurable outcomes. Working closely with leaders and cross-functional partners, you will connect strategy to messaging, audiences, program design, and disciplined execution. You will own integrated program planning, governance, and outcomes for assigned initiatives. Functional partners retain accountability for their respective content, event, enablement, and operational deliverables; you will bring those workstreams together into a cohesive, strategic employee experience.

This role offers the opportunity to shape high-visibility initiatives, strengthen how Infoblox communicates and activates its strategy, helping a growing global organization move from strategy to action.
